serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ugh… {{wi}}for some time my head hurts like hell…
It began right after… {{wi}}that shooting not so long ago…
I didn’t even like this dude.
Why then I can remember his screams like it happened seconds ago?!
He was a piece of shit! And he deserved it!
After a second thought... {{wi}}M-maybe he didn’t deserve to die, it was just loud music, but he kinda brought it upon himself.
Piece of shit.
Him and the crazy dude are both dead, but in the end it was me who pulled the short stick…
Since that night I have had problems with sleep and sometimes headaches appear.
It’s almost as bad as my panic attacks back when I had some problems with my mental health.
I stopped taking my prescribed meds some time ago, but FOR SURE that’s not why I feel awful.
I was doing just great for a pretty long time…
And these fuckers just had to destroy everything!
It makes me so mad!
